[[File:Rodian_waitress.jpg|thumb|250px|A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] waitress at the [[Falling Star Saloon]].]]
A '''waiter''' or '''waitress''' was an individual or, in some cases, a [[Service droid/Legends|droid]], who took [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and drink orders at restaurants or diners.
